blocks.text:
You will be met at the airport and taken by private transfer to Alvear Palace. For more than a century, the hotel has been associated with the classic atmosphere of old Buenos Aires.

The rest of the day is free. You can stroll around San Telmo, explore Palermo and its restaurants, or head to Recoleta. The city combines European façades, old bars, markets, graffiti, wine venues and late dinners. Its streets become especially lively in the evening: tango plays in some neighbourhoods, while steakhouses and small wine bars welcome guests in others. Your guide can recommend restaurants serving Argentine, Italian or European cuisine, as well as bars with views of the city.
